-->

- [ ] Bug fix

- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
t0-56-po2vlan topo introduces tagged portchannel, need update current test cases to verify traffic between tagged interface and untagged interface.

#### How did you do it?
* Update current test cases:
Send untagged broadcast traffic.
Send tagged broadcast traffic.
Send invalid tagged broadcast traffic.
Send tagged unicast traffic.
Send untagged unicast traffic.
Send QinQ unicast traffic.
* Add new test case:
Send tagged and untagged unicast traffic.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run test cases with t0-56-po2vlan topo and t0 topo.
